## Helpful Keys

```{r Variables -- Hello world}
"Hello world"

message = "Hello world"

print(message)

message

ls()
```


```{r Variables -- Data Types}

first_name = c("Harry", "Ron", "Hermione")
last_name = c("Potter", "Weasley", "Granger")
n_kids = c(1,7,1)
survived = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE)
pet = factor(c("Owl", "Rat", "Cat"))

class(first_name)
class(last_name)
class(n_kids)
class(survived)
class(pet)

harrypotter <- data.frame(
  first_name,
  last_name,
  n_kids,
  survived,
  pet)

str(harrypotter)
```

library(tidyverse)

```{r Reading in data -- Are you in the right directory?}

getwd()

harrypotter_characters = read_xlsx("Workshop-Sessions/Introduction-to-Coding/harry_potter_characters.xlsx")

```

```{r}
# Structure of data
str(harrypotter_characters)

# Number of survivors
sum(harrypotter_characters$survived)

# Number who died
sum(!harrypotter_characters$survived)
```
